APP.NAME: LocalConnect
APP.TAGLINE: Find what you need near you

HOME.TITLE: What do you need?
HOME.SUPPORTING_TEXT: Connect directly with trusted local drivers, property owners, and transport providers in your village or town.
HOME.CATEGORIES_TITLE: What are you looking for today?
HOME.CATEGORIES_SUBTITLE: Choose a category below to find resources and submit your request

VEHICLE.TITLE: Vehicle with Driver
VEHICLE.DESCRIPTION: Hire cars, SUVs, Bolero, and Tempo Travellers with experienced drivers for weddings and trips.

ROOM.TITLE: Room & Stay
ROOM.DESCRIPTION: Find nearby guest houses, family rooms, lodges, and accommodations for short or extended stays.

TRANSPORT.TITLE: Goods Transport
TRANSPORT.DESCRIPTION: Move agricultural produce, construction materials, furniture, or heavy luggage with local vehicles.

EMERGENCY.TITLE: Emergency Assistance
EMERGENCY.DESCRIPTION: Quickly locate available urgent transport, vehicle breakdown help, or emergency local shelter.

HOW_IT_WORKS.TITLE: How LocalConnect Works
HOW_IT_WORKS.SUBTITLE: Four simple steps to find and request local resources when you need them
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP1_DESC: Pick vehicles with drivers, rooms, goods transport, or urgent local assistance.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP2_DESC: Enter your location, date, time, and specific resource requirements.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP3_DESC: Check available mock options, provider ratings, distance, and indicative prices.
HOW_IT_WORKS.STEP4_DESC: Submit your request and track its status directly in the application.

BENEFITS.TITLE: Built for Local Communities
BENEFITS.LOCAL_DESC: Direct connections with operators and property owners from your own area.
BENEFITS.PRICING_DESC: Clear pricing breakdown with no hidden booking fees or surprise charges.
BENEFITS.FAST_DESC: Designed for quick turnaround, even in villages and semi-urban towns.
BENEFITS.SIMPLE_DESC: Simple mobile-first design in Hindi and English for all smartphone users.

URGENT.LABEL: Urgent help
URGENT.TITLE: Need something urgently?
URGENT.DESCRIPTION: Look for available local resources that can help right now with transport or assistance.

PROVIDER.LABEL: For providers
PROVIDER.TITLE: Have a vehicle, room or transport vehicle?
PROVIDER.DESCRIPTION: List your resource on LocalConnect and let people in your community find and request your service.

VEHICLE_SEARCH.LABEL: Vehicle request
VEHICLE_SEARCH.TITLE: Search Vehicles with Driver
VEHICLE_SEARCH.WITH_DRIVER_NOTE: All vehicles are provided with verified drivers. Self-drive rentals are not offered in this service.
VEHICLE_SEARCH.PICKUP_PLACEHOLDER: Enter pickup village, town or landmark
VEHICLE_SEARCH.DESTINATION_PLACEHOLDER: Enter destination village, town or landmark
VEHICLE_SEARCH.ROUTE_NOTE: Destination details are saved for request submission. Vehicle availability is determined by driver status, date, time, and pickup proximity.

ERRORS.DATE_PAST: Travel date cannot be in the past

VEHICLE_RESULTS.TITLE: Available Vehicles with Drivers
VEHICLE_RESULTS.SUBTITLE: Showing mock vehicles matching your search criteria and pickup proximity
VEHICLE_RESULTS.AVAILABILITY_NOTE: Mock Availability: Drivers receive your complete pickup-to-destination itinerary before confirming your request.
VEHICLE_RESULTS.NO_RESULTS_TITLE: No vehicles found matching your criteria
VEHICLE_RESULTS.NO_RESULTS_DESC: Try adjusting your vehicle type or travel dates to find available drivers nearby.

ROOM_SEARCH.TITLE: Find Rooms & Local Stays
ROOM_SEARCH.SUBTITLE: Discover clean guest houses, family suites, lodges, and budget stays near your destination.
ROOM_SEARCH.LOCATION_PLACEHOLDER: Enter town, area or landmark (e.g. Near Bus Stand)
ROOM_SEARCH.ROUTE_NOTE: Room availability is based on property capacity and stay dates.

ERRORS.CHECKIN_PAST: Check-in date cannot be in the past
ERRORS.CHECKOUT_BEFORE: Check-out date must be after check-in date

ROOM_RESULTS.TITLE: Available Rooms & Stays
ROOM_RESULTS.NO_RESULTS_DESC: Try adjusting your dates, guest count, or searching for a different area.

TRANSPORT_SEARCH.TITLE: Find Transport for Goods & Cargo
TRANSPORT_SEARCH.SUBTITLE: Hire local mini trucks, pickups, and carriers for agricultural produce, construction materials, and luggage.
TRANSPORT_SEARCH.LOAD_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. 20 bags wheat, 2 tons sand, 1 refrigerator
TRANSPORT_SEARCH.ROUTE_NOTE: Destination details are part of your request. Transporters review cargo specifications and route before accepting.

ERRORS.DATE_PAST: Transport date cannot be in the past
ERRORS.GOODS_TYPE_REQUIRED: Please select the type of goods

TRANSPORT_RESULTS.TITLE: Available Goods Transport Vehicles
TRANSPORT_RESULTS.SUBTITLE: Local transport carriers ready for freight and cargo movement
TRANSPORT_RESULTS.AVAILABILITY_NOTE: Indicative Pricing: Final rates depend on exact weight, loading assistance, and travel distance.
TRANSPORT_RESULTS.NO_RESULTS_DESC: Try adjusting your cargo vehicle type or date to find available carriers.

TRANSPORT_TYPES.SMALL_CARRIER: Tata Ace / Chhota Hathi (Up to 750 kg)
TRANSPORT_TYPES.PICKUP_TRUCK: Pickup Truck / Bolero Maxi (Up to 1.5 tons)

EMERGENCY.TITLE: Urgent Local Assistance
EMERGENCY.SUBTITLE: Quickly request nearby assistance for urgent transit, breakdown, or medical travel
EMERGENCY.DISCLAIMER: Demo Prototype Notice: This application is a prototype and DOES NOT contact real emergency services (112/108) or guarantee real-time response. For life-threatening emergencies, call official emergency numbers immediately.
EMERGENCY.LOCATION_PLACEHOLDER: Enter village, road, milestone or landmark
EMERGENCY.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Describe the emergency situation and any specific requirements
EMERGENCY.ERROR_TYPE_REQUIRED: Please select the type of assistance
EMERGENCY.ERROR_TIME_REQUIRED: Time is required for scheduled requests
EMERGENCY.HELPLINES_SUBTITLE: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, road accidents, crimes, fires, or medical transport, call statutory services directly.
EMERGENCY.HELPLINE_112_DESC: Centralized police, fire, health, and disaster dispatch across India.
EMERGENCY.HELPLINE_108_DESC: Free 24x7 emergency medical dispatch & life support transport.
EMERGENCY.HELPLINE_102_DESC: Government transport for pregnant mothers & infants under JSSK.
EMERGENCY.HELPLINE_101_DESC: Rapid response teams for building fires, agricultural burns & rescues.
EMERGENCY.HELPLINE_100_DESC: Immediate police station dispatch for crime, conflict, or highway incidents.
EMERGENCY.HELPLINE_1073_DESC: NHAI 24x7 highway safety, towing, and ambulance on national highways.
EMERGENCY.HELPLINE_1091_DESC: Dedicated 24-hour protection and rapid support for women in distress.
EMERGENCY.COMMUNITY_ALERT_SUBTITLE: Broadcast urgent breakdown or non-emergency requirements to verified local providers.
EMERGENCY.TRUTHFUL_DISPATCH_NOTICE: Truthful Dispatch Guarantee: LocalConnect never simulates false dispatches. Status advances only after a verified provider confirms acceptance.

DETAILS.NOT_FOUND: Resource details could not be found.

REQUEST_SUMMARY.TITLE: Review Request Summary
REQUEST_SUMMARY.DEMO_NOTICE: Demo Request Notice: Submitting this form creates a demonstration request in local browser storage. No real SMS, phone call, or notification is sent to any real provider.

CONFIRMATION.TITLE: Demo Request Submitted!
CONFIRMATION.DEMO_NOTICE: This is a demonstration confirmation. Your request has been stored in your browser's demo request list. In the production application, the provider would receive instant SMS and WhatsApp alerts.
CONFIRMATION.NEXT_STEPS: You can view your request status and history under 'My Requests'. You may cancel or monitor demo updates there.
CONFIRMATION.NOT_FOUND: Request reference could not be found.

MY_REQUESTS.TITLE: My Requests & Booking Status
MY_REQUESTS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: You haven't submitted any resource requests yet. Explore our categories to request vehicles, stays, or transport.
MY_REQUESTS.DEMO_NOTE: Demo Client State: Persisted in local browser storage.
